result.hard_numeric_fact_text: Management: YTD FY27 order intake >Rs9,600 cr (MANAGEMENT CLAIM). Single announced orders were Rs1,014 cr (10 Oct) and Rs1,030 cr (8 Oct), not Rs9,600/8,600 cr as the dossier event rows show.
result.thesis: Order intake is strong (YTD >Rs9,600 cr claimed; first 765 kV PSP evacuation order) and P/E is 17x after a 58% price fall. But reported fundamentals deteriorated: EBITDA -16.9% YoY, PAT -41.7%, margin 5.8%, CFO/PAT -0.68, receivable days 179, ND/EBITDA 2.86, interest cover 1.8. The cause of the 58% fall is not in the extracted filings (unknown). A crash is a reason to research, not evidence. Not underwritable until cash flow turns.
chain_missing_links: Cause of the 58% price fall unknown
